proves.claim: clause 1: a remote attempt past 120000ms holds no local pool lease while a competing local fallback takes and releases one.

cli.io-static-stage.lease-not-held-while.why: A remote runner wait must not occupy a local static-check slot and block local fallback work.

proves.claim: clause 2: local fallback takes and releases the pool lease, completes without timer killing, and writes an exact-tree memo.

cli.io-static-stage.local-fallback-takes.why: Fallback work still needs bounded local admission and the green result must be reusable only for its exact tree.
